from flask import Flask, request, g
import sqlite3
app = Flask(__name__)

DATABASE = 'users.db'

def get_db():
    db = getattr(g, '_database', None)
    if db is None:
        db = g._database = sqlite3.connect(DATABASE)
    return db

@app.route('/bored', methods=['POST'])
def bored():
    username = request.form['username']
    games = request.form['games']

    query = "UPDATE users SET games = '%s' WHERE username = '%s'" % (games, username)

    db = get_db()
    cursor = db.cursor()
    cursor.execute(query)
    db.commit()

    return 'Account updated!'
